description: Open reading frames in all 6 frames (3 forward + 3 reverse-complement): each start codon (default ATG) to its first in-frame stop codon of the chosen NCBI genetic code (default Standard TAA/TAG/TGA), stop included, length >= minLength nucleotides; every in-frame start is reported (nested ORFs, Rosalind). Options follow NCBI ORFfinder: genetic_code, startCodons, nested, includeOpenEnded, minLengthExcludesStop, bothStrands.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive); an ambiguous codon ends an ORF only when every concrete codon is a stop, never starts one, and is otherwise read through

minLength.description: Minimum ORF length in nucleotides, stop codon included unless minLengthExcludesStop (default 100)

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table whose stop codons end ORFs (default 1 = Standard); tables 27, 28, 31 (dual-coding stops) are rejected

startCodons.description: AtgOnly (default) | GeneticCodeStarts (ATG + the table's alternative initiation codons) | AnySenseCodon (stop-to-stop); case-insensitive

nested.description: true (default): every in-frame start; false: only the most upstream start per stop (NCBI ORFfinder default)

includeOpenEnded.description: true: also report 3'-partial ORFs that reach the sequence end without a stop (isTerminated=false)

minLengthExcludesStop.description: true: minLength excludes the stop codon (NCBI ORFfinder -ml, EMBOSS getorf -minsize)

bothStrands.description: true (default): both strands; false: forward only

position.description: 0-based start in the scanned strand (input, or its reverse complement when isReverseComplement)

end.description: 0-based inclusive end in input (forward-strand) coordinates, stop codon included

isTerminated.description: false for an open-ended (no stop) ORF

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
Minimum ORF length must be at least 1
Genetic code 27/28/31 has dual-coding stop codons / unknown table / unknown startCodons
